arxiv-1509-05836.title: Classification of isolated singularities of nonnegative solutions to fractional semi-linear elliptic equations and the existence results
arxiv-1509-05836.description: Abstract Huyuan Chen Alexander Quaas Abstract. In this paper, we classify the singularities of nonnegative solutions to fractional elliptic equation \begin{array}[]{lll}\displaystyle(-\Delta)^{\alpha}u=u^{p}&{\rm in}\quad\Omega\setminus\{0\},\\[5.69054pt] \phantom{(-\Delta)^{\alpha}}\displaystyle u=0&{\rm in}\quad\mathbb{R}^{N}\setminus\Omega,\end{array} (1) where p>1 , \Omega is a bounded, C^{2} domain in \mathbb{R}^{N} containing the origin, N\geq 2 and the fractional Laplacian (-\Delta)^{\alpha} is defined in the principle value sense.

arxiv-1708-00335.creator: Gangli Liu

arxiv-1905-13567.title: Musical Composition Style Transfer via Disentangled Timbre Representations
arxiv-1905-13567.creator: Yun-Ning Hung, I-Tung Chiang, Yi-An Chen, Yi-Hsuan Yang
arxiv-1905-13567.description: Abstract Music creation involves not only composing the different parts (e.g., melody, chords) of a musical work but also arranging/selecting the instruments to play the different parts. While the former has received increasing attention, the latter has not been much investigated.

arxiv-2001-04857.title: The first uniformly finite homology group with coefficients in ℤ {\mathbb{Z}} and a characterisation of its vanishing in the transitive case
arxiv-2001-04857.creator: Rémi Bottinelli, Tom Kaiser
arxiv-2001-04857.description: Abstract We study the first uniformly finite homology group of Block and Weinberger for uniformly locally finite graphs, with coefficients in ℤ \mathbb{Z} and ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}_{2} . When the graph is a tree, or coefficients are in ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}_{2} , a characterisation of the group is obtained.

arxiv-2104-04574.title: Model fusion with physics-guided machine learning
arxiv-2104-04574.creator: Suraj Pawar, Omer San, Aditya Nair, Adil Rasheed, Trond Kvamsdal
arxiv-2104-04574.description: Abstract The unprecedented amount of data generated from experiments, field observations, and large-scale numerical simulations at a wide range of spatio-temporal scales have enabled the rapid advancement of data-driven and especially deep learning models in the field of fluid mechanics. Although these methods are proven successful for many applications, there is a grand challenge of improving their generalizability .

arxiv-2109-11216.title: Union and Intersection of all Justifications
arxiv-2109-11216.creator: Jieying Chen, Yue Ma, Rafael Peñaloza, Hui Yang
arxiv-2109-11216.description: Abstract We present new algorithms for computing the union and intersection of all justifications for a given ontological consequence without first computing the set of all justifications. Through an empirical evaluation, we show that our approach works well in practice for expressive description logics.

arxiv-2309-17353.title: Modelling uncertainties and prompt b-jet identification in t ​ t ¯ ​ b ​ b ¯ t\bar{t}b\bar{b} production with dilepton signatures at the LHC
arxiv-2309-17353.description: Abstract As one of the primary backgrounds to p ​ p → t ​ t ¯ ​ H ​ ( H → b ​ b ¯ ) pp\to t\bar{t}H(H\to b\bar{b}) , the QCD process of t ​ t ¯ ​ b ​ b ¯ t\bar{t}b\bar{b} hadroproduction demands very accurate theoretical predictions and estimates of uncertainties.

arxiv-2402-06698.creator: Zihan Dong, Xinyu Fan, Zhiyuan Peng
arxiv-2402-06698.description: Abstract . Financial market predictions utilize historical data to anticipate future stock prices and market trends. Traditionally, these predictions have focused on the statistical analysis of quantitative factors, such as stock prices, trading volumes, inflation rates, and changes in industrial production.

arxiv-2510-06759.title: Fast-forwardable Lindbladians imply quantum phase estimation
arxiv-2510-06759.creator: Zhong-Xia Shang, Naixu Guo, Patrick Rebentrost, Alán Aspuru-Guzik, Tongyang Li, Qi Zhao
arxiv-2510-06759.description: Abstract Quantum phase estimation (QPE) and Lindbladian dynamics are both foundational in quantum information science and central to quantum algorithm design. In this work, we bridge these two concepts: certain simple Lindbladian processes can be adapted to perform QPE-type tasks. However, unlike QPE, which achieves Heisenberg-limit scaling, these Lindbladian evolutions are restricted to standard quantum limit complexity.

pmc-11304470.title: Negative allosteric modulation of CB1 cannabinoid receptor signalling decreases intravenous morphine self‐administration and relapse in mice
pmc-11304470.creator: Idaira Oliva, Fezaan Kazi, Lucas N Cantwell, Ganesh A Thakur, Jonathon D Crystal, Andrea G Hohmann
pmc-11304470.description: The endocannabinoid system interacts with the reward system to modulate responsiveness to natural reinforcers, as well as drugs of abuse. Previous preclinical studies suggested that direct blockade of CB1 cannabinoid receptors (CB1R) could be leveraged as a potential pharmacological approach to treat substance use disorder, but this strategy failed during clinical trials due to severe psychiatric side effects.

pmc-11353517.title: Effects of Bergamot (Citrus bergamia Risso) By-Product on Growth Performance and Meat Quality of Growing Rabbits
pmc-11353517.creator: Manuel Scerra, Francesco Foti, Pasquale Caparra, Matteo Bognanno, Paolo Fortugno, Domenico Autolitano, Domenico Viglianti, Marco Sebastiano Bella, Marco Sebastiano Cannone, Luigi Chies
pmc-11353517.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study aimed to investigate the effects of feeding dried bergamot pulp to rabbits on animal performance and meat quality. Thirty rabbits were assigned to two groups (balanced for body weight, 804.4 ± 2.35 g) and fed individually for 60 days a basal diet (control) or the basal diet in which part of the cereals was replaced with 10% of dried bergamot pulp (DBP).

pmc-11435163.title: The Impact of Ten Days of Periodic Fasting on the Modulation of the Longevity Gene in Overweight and Obese Individuals: A Quasi-Experimental Study
pmc-11435163.creator: Nurma Yuliyanasari, Eva Nabiha Zamri, Purwo Sri Rejeki, Muhammad Miftahussurur, Benjamin D Horne
pmc-11435163.description: Background: Fasting potentially alters the aging process induced by obesity by regulating telomere integrity, which is related to longevity genes. However, the impact of periodic fasting (PF) on the expression of longevity genes, particularly Forkhead Box O Transcription Factors (FOXO3a) and the Human Telomerase Reverse Transcriptase (hTERT), is not fully understood.

pmc-11454816.title: 7899 Mixture Of Urinary Concentrations Of Phenols And Phthalate Metabolites In Relation To Serum Levels Of Lipid Biomarkers Among Pregnant Women: Results From The EARTH Study
pmc-11454816.creator: Xilin Shen, Maximilien Génard-Walton, Paige L Williams, Tamarra James-Todd, Jennifer B Ford, Kathryn M Rexrode, Dan Zhang, Jorge E Chavarro, Russ B Hauser, Lidia Minguez Alarcon
pmc-11454816.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Minguez Alarcon: None.Given the limited evidence on endocrine-disrupting chemicals (EDCs), evaluated as mixture, in relation to lipid biomarkers during pregnancy, we examined whether mixtures of urinary concentrations of bisphenol A (BPA), parabens and phthalate metabolites were associated with serum lipid levels among 175 pregnant women who enrolled in Environment and Reproductive Health (EARTH) Study from 2005 to 2017.

pmc-11573041.creator: Rohan Chawla
pmc-11573041.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). us examine the established facts. This disease was earlier referred to as central serous retinopathy, but the name was changed to choroidopathy when evidence from imaging studies revealed that the primary abnormality appeared to be in the choroid.

pmc-12808775.title: Transcriptional responses in feeder time-trained foragers suggest diverse interactions between the circadian clock and mushroom bodies in honey bees
pmc-12808775.creator: Tiyasa Roy, Rikesh Jain, Axel Brockmann
pmc-12808775.description: A hundred years ago Karl von Frisch and his students demonstrated that honey bees use time-memory to schedule their daily foraging flights. However, till today little is known about molecular processes and functional interactions between memory centers and the circadian clock underlying the capability to form time-memories in animals.

pmc-13096801.title: Harnessing toxin-mediated ribosome stalling as a complementary tool to annotate bacterial ORFs
pmc-13096801.creator: Eduardo A Troian, Valdir C Barth, Unnati Chauhan, Haiyan Zheng, Caifeng Zhao, Jumei Zeng, Robert N Husson, Nancy A Woychik
pmc-13096801.description: The Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) VapC4 endoribonuclease toxin exclusively cleaves and inactivates tRNACys, which leads to extensive ribosome stalling at Cys codons. Serendipitously, the precise position of stalled ribosomes is revealed within our 5′ RNA-seq datasets used to identify and validate the tRNA target of the toxin, precluding the need for Ribo-seq.

pmc-13656623.title: Markedly elevated blood concentrations of everolimus during concomitant posaconazole therapy in a liver transplant recipient: a case report
pmc-13656623.creator: Machiko Hirai, Keisuke Umemura, Yoshiki Katada, Yusuke Kojima, Hiroki Ishimura, Yurie Katsube, Daiki Hira, Shoichi Kageyama, Masahiro Tsuda, Shunsaku Nakagawa, Etsuro Hatano, Tomohiro Terada
pmc-13656623.description: BackgroundEverolimus (EVL) is widely used as an immunosuppressive agent in combination with calcineurin inhibitors, including tacrolimus (TAC), after liver transplantation. Posaconazole (PSCZ) is a triazole antifungal agent used for the treatment and prophylaxis of invasive fungal infections. Because PSCZ is a potent inhibitor of cytochrome P450 (CYP) 3A4, clinically significant drug–drug interactions with CYP3A substrates may occur.

pmc-13664222.title: A Small-Molecule TrkB Agonist Promotes Synaptic Resilience Against Aβ and Tau Oligomers and Mitigates Alterations in TrkB-Akt and Fyn Signaling
pmc-13664222.creator: Tao Yang, Kevin C. Tran, Albert Leng, Vanessa F. Langness, Stephen M. Massa, Frank M. Longo
pmc-13664222.description: Highlights What are the main findings? In vitro, PTX-BD4-3 protected against oAβ-induced synaptic protein loss and elevation of Fyn, NR2B, and tau phosphorylation. Preservation of synaptic proteins following oAβ exposure was TrkB-dependent. PTX-BD4-3 also protected against oTau-induced dendritic spine loss.
